Algorithmic bias.question: What is Algorithmic bias? Technological phenomenon with social implications.
Algorithmic bias.fact: Algorithmic bias describes systematic and repeatable harmful tendency in a computerized sociotechnical system to create "unfair" outcomes, such as "privileging" one category over another in ways that may or may not be different from the intended function of the algorithm.   For example, algorithmic bias has been observed in search engine results and social media platforms.

Algorithmic bias.subject: Computer & IT
Algorithmic bias.question: This bias has only recently been addressed in legal frameworks, such as the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (enforced in _____) and the Artificial Intelligence Act (proposed in 202
Algorithmic bias.fact: This bias has only recently been addressed in legal frameworks, such as the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (enforced in 2018) and the Artificial Intelligence Act (proposed in 2021 and adopted in 2024).

Algorithmic cooling.subject: Computer & IT
Algorithmic cooling.question: The _____ was Algorithm in quantum information theory.
Algorithmic cooling.fact: Algorithmic cooling is an algorithmic method for transferring heat (or entropy) from some qubits to others or outside the system and into the environment, which results in a cooling effect.

Algorithmic cooling.subject: Computer & IT
Algorithmic cooling.question: This method uses regular quantum operations on ensembles of qubits, and it can be shown that it can succeed beyond _____'s bound on data compression
Algorithmic cooling.fact: This method uses regular quantum operations on ensembles of qubits, and it can be shown that it can succeed beyond Shannon's bound on data compression.

Algorithmic cooling.subject: Computer & IT
Algorithmic cooling.question: It is limited by a variant of _____'s bound on data compression and it can asymptotically reach quite close to the bound
Algorithmic cooling.fact: It is limited by a variant of Shannon's bound on data compression and it can asymptotically reach quite close to the bound. A more general method, "irreversible algorithmic cooling", makes use of irreversible transfer of heat outside of the system and into the environment (and therefore may bypass the Shannon bound).

Algorithmic efficiency.subject: Computer & IT
Algorithmic efficiency.question: What is Algorithmic efficiency? Property of an algorithm.
Algorithmic efficiency.fact: In computer science, algorithmic efficiency is a property of an algorithm which relates to the amount of computational resources used by the algorithm.   Algorithmic efficiency can be thought of as analogous to engineering productivity for a repeating or continuous process.

Algorithmic game theory.question: What is Algorithmic game theory? Study of algorithms in strategic environments.
Algorithmic game theory.fact: Algorithmic game theory (AGT) is an interdisciplinary field at the intersection of game theory and computer science, focused on understanding and designing algorithms for environments where multiple strategic agents interact.

Algorithmic information theory.question: What is Algorithmic information theory? Subfield of information theory and computer science.

Algorithmic paradigm.subject: Computer & IT
Algorithmic paradigm.question: The _____ was Technique or strategy underlying a variety of algorithms.
Algorithmic paradigm.fact: An algorithmic paradigm or algorithm design paradigm is a generic model or framework which underlies the design of a class of algorithms. An algorithmic paradigm is an abstraction higher than the notion of an algorithm, just as an algorithm is an abstraction higher than a computer program.
